name: kumiho-memory
description: Persistent graph-native memory for Codex — recalls context across sessions, stores decisions and preferences, and mines commits into a git-anchored decision graph (Decision Memory). Cloud (API token) or self-hosted CE.

interface.longDescription: Onboard Kumiho Cloud or self-hosted CE, recall context across sessions, preserve decisions and preferences, and explain why code changed with graph-native memory.
defaultPrompt: Set up Kumiho Memory for this Codex installation.
Recall what we previously decided about this project.
Remember this decision and its rationale for next time.
